page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Above the text a woodcut ornament band. Title dedication in large capitals and italics at top, then body text with a historiated initial at left. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible in the background and is not transcribed. Signature mark at foot right.

main_text.head: MAGNIFICENTISSIMIS, NOBILISSIMIS, STRENUISSIMIS, AMPLISSIMIS, D.D. CONSULIBUS, PROCONSULIBUS, QUAESTORIBUS, ARCHIOECONOMO, Totique Augusto Inclytae Reipublicae TIGURINAE SENATUI; Patriae Patribus, Ecclesiae Nutritiis; DOMINIS SUIS GRATIOSISSIMIS.
main_text.p: Ost gravem illam, PROCERES MAGNIFICENTISSIMI, cladem, qua quondam Allophyli Israelem afflixerunt, David, Regni sui auspicia jacturus, filiis Jehudae edixit, ut קשת jaculari arcu discerent. Praesagiebat enim ei animus, fore, ut hostes
Note: the initial letter P is a large woodcut initial and is joined to the word "Ost" as "Post".

page.notes: The historiated initial P is joined to the text as "Post". The Hebrew word is printed as קשת. Show-through of the reverse page is visible faintly in the background and is not transcribed. The first line of body text is "Ost gravem illam" as printed, with the initial P missing from the printed line. Words with uncertain letters are not marked.
